name: missing-result

pages.text:
Test: Hemoglobin
Units: g/dL
Specimen: whole blood

concern: Block without a Result line is ignored even though optional fields parsed

name: duplicate-result

pages.text:
Test: Glucose
Result: 5.4 mmol/L
Result: 5.9 mmol/L

concern: A second Result in the same block aborts the whole block

name: cross-page-block
concern: A block split across pages never merges; an orphan Result outside any block is ignored

name: wrong-clinical-labels

pages.text:
Test: Lipid panel
Result: LDL 3.4 mmol/L
Diagnosis: dyslipidaemia

concern: Unknown clinical label such as Diagnosis aborts the block; no interpretation is produced

name: qualitative-unicode

pages.text:
Analyte: SARS-CoV-2 RNA
Result: detected ≥ 1.0 ×10³ copies/mL
Units: copies/mL

concern: Qualitative result and Unicode comparators are preserved verbatim, never interpreted

name: truncated-final-line

pages.text:
Test: TSH
Result: 1.2 mIU/L
Test: Free T4
Result: 1

concern: Character-truncated final physical line is dropped so an incomplete Result cannot become a candidate

name: ambiguous-literal-date
concern: Ambiguous date literal is kept verbatim in the date evidence, never parsed or normalized

name: multiple-block-offsets

pages.text:
Test: Sodium
Result: 139 mmol/L

Test: Potassium
Result: 4.2 mmol/L

concern: Two blocks on one page yield stable IDs from the exact UTF-16 offset of each block-start line
